message.content: In the California governor race, Becerra's documented Gaza-related statements include a May 2024 World Health Assembly speech calling for a ceasefire, hostage release, expanded humanitarian aid, and a two-state solution. In a 2026 interview, he criticized Netanyahu's conduct and called for international accountability without confirming the term genocide, and in an October 2026 debate he referred to the U.S.-Israeli war in Iran as illegal. On endorsements tied to this issue focus, CAIR Action endorsed Becerra for the general, Muslim Democrats of Southern California endorsed him, and the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club carried forward its primary endorsement into November. Independent spending supporting Becerra included $17.2 million from a labor-and-community-health coalition, though the relevance of that expenditure to Palestine-related positions is unestablished.
